title: Checkout as guest

entry.title: How would you like to continue?
entry.body: You can order without an account. If you already have one, signing in keeps your addresses and past orders together.

contact.title: Who is this for
contact.fullNameHint: The name the driver will ask for.
contact.emailHint: Leave blank if you would rather use a mobile number.
contact.mobileHint: Include the country code, for example +971 50 123 4567.

errors.nameRequired: Enter the name the driver should ask for.
errors.contactRequired: Enter an email address or a mobile number — either one is enough.
errors.emailInvalid: That does not look like an email address.
errors.mobileInvalid: Enter the number with its country code, starting with +.

address.title: Where it goes
address.outOfZoneTitle: This kitchen does not deliver to {{area}}
address.outOfZoneBody: We would rather say so now than take an order we cannot fulfil. Change the area, or choose a kitchen that delivers to you.
address.outOfZoneBrowse: Find a kitchen that delivers here

verify.subtitle: We sent a code to {{destination}}. Entering it lets us place the order — an order we cannot confirm is a promise made to a typo.
verify.otpFallback: We could not check that code just now. Try again in a moment.

review.marketingLabel: Send me offers and new menus
review.unverified: Confirm your contact in step 1 to place the order.
review.finePrint: Pay the driver in cash when it arrives. Nothing is charged now.

session.expiredBody: Guest checkouts do not last long, which is deliberate on a shared device. Your basket is still here — enter your details again to carry on.

order.keepReference: Keep it — it is how you find this order later.
order.cancelledBody: It will not be cooked or delivered, and nothing is owed for it.
order.notFoundTitle: We could not find that order
order.notFoundBody: Check the reference. Guest orders are also removed once their retention window ends, so a very old reference may no longer exist.

lead.placed: Waiting for the kitchen to accept it.
lead.confirmed: The kitchen has accepted it and it is in the queue.
lead.preparing: The kitchen is cooking and packing your order.
lead.out_for_delivery: It has left the kitchen and is on its way to you.
lead.delivered: It has been handed over. Enjoy your meal.
lead.cancelled: Nothing will be cooked or delivered.

preparing.title: Cooking
preparing.detail: The kitchen is cooking your order

out_for_delivery.title: Out for delivery
out_for_delivery.detail: On its way to your address

order.courierDetail: Courier details are not shared on this page.

convert.title: Keep this order in an account?
convert.body: We already have everything an account needs. Choose a password and this order moves across with it — or carry on without one, which is a real choice and not a delay.
convert.marketing: Send me offers and new menus
convert.marketingHint: Asked again because your checkout answer was about one order, not a standing account.
convert.noThanks: No thanks, continue as a guest
convert.verifiedNote: Your contact is already confirmed, so there is no second code to enter.
convert.doneBody: You are signed in, and this order is on your account.
convert.declined: No problem. Your order is unchanged and we have not created anything.

deletion.title: Delete my data
deletion.subtitle: Tell us the email address or mobile number you ordered with, and we will remove what we hold against it.
deletion.emailHint: The one you used when ordering.
deletion.sentBody: If we hold anything for that address, a code is on its way. We do not say either way — telling you whether an address is known to us would be telling anyone who asked.
deletion.confirmBody: Your contact details, delivery addresses, dietary information and guest orders are erased. There is no copy to restore from and no way to reverse it.
deletion.doneBody: Everything we held against that address is gone.
deletion.suppressionNote: One record is kept on purpose: a one-way fingerprint of the address, so that "never contact me again" outlives the deletion of everything else. It cannot be read back or used to reach you.
deletion.invalidCode: That code is not right. A code will also fail if we hold nothing for the address you gave.

eyebrow: No account needed · Cash on delivery available
saveTitle: Save this order to an account?
saveBody: Offered right after you place it — it keeps this order and your contact, nothing else.
